phases.name: setup
entry_messages: Welcome to Cactus Gulch, spring 1884. The town celebrates its 20th anniversary at the Silver Dollar Saloon.
exit_messages: The festive air settles as folks gather for the evening's events.
instructions: This is the start of the game. Introduce yourself in character. Establish your presence in the saloon.

phases.name: zeke_death_announcement
entry_messages: The stable hand bursts in with terrible news - Zeke Calhoun has been found dead in the stables!
His body shows signs of a fight, hands were bound (ropes cut), and his shirt pocket was sliced open.
No clear cause of death - no shooting, strangling, or fatal head wound visible.
No one may leave town until this is resolved.
exit_messages: The initial shock subsides. Now the real investigation begins.
instructions: React to Zeke's death in character. Consider your relationship with him.
You may express grief, suspicion, or strategic concern.

phases.name: stagecoach_arrival
entry_messages: The stagecoach arrives with supplies and mail.
The telegraph system has been repaired and is now operational.
exit_messages: Time to get down to business.
instructions: The telegraph is now available. You may send messages if needed.
Special items may be delivered to certain individuals.

phases.name: investigation
entry_messages: Investigation phase begins. Gather clues, interrogate suspects, form alliances.
The scene of the crime can be examined. Question witnesses. Share information strategically.
exit_messages: The investigation has revealed much, but mysteries remain.
instructions: Use abilities to discover secrets, share clues strategically, interrogate others.
Actions: speak, interrogate, accuse, share_clue, negotiate, pickpocket (if you have ability).
Build alliances or sow distrust as fits your goals.

Dan Fairweather: You can arrest suspects using your arrest ability. Gather evidence first.
John Paulson: As judge, you must remain impartial but gather information for the judgment.
Lucy Calhoun: Seek justice for your father. Who wanted him dead?
Clem Parham: Ensure the railroad deal proceeds. Control the narrative.
Mel Easton: Counter Clem's influence. Build support for an ethical deal.

phases.name: judgment_phase
entry_messages: Judge Paulson calls the court to order.
The judgment concerns ownership of Fat Bull Range after the card game between Zeke and Doc Faraday.
Was Doc cheating? Does the land belong to Lucy (Zeke's heir) or Doc?
This decision affects the railroad deal and the fate of the Indian burial grounds.
exit_messages: The judgment has been rendered. Its consequences will unfold.
instructions: Present testimony, evidence (like marked cards), and arguments.
Judge Paulson (or Dan if Judge is discredited) must make the final ruling.
Actions: speak, testify, support, oppose, present_evidence.

John Paulson: You must deliver judgment. Physical evidence of cheating would make this easier. Beware of pressure from Clem.
Dan Fairweather: If the Judge is compromised, YOU must make the judgment. Prepare for this possibility.
Lucy Calhoun: Argue for your inheritance. Doc cheated your father.
Doc Faraday: Defend your win. Without proof of cheating, the land is yours.
Blaise Sadler: You hold the marked cards. Will you reveal them?
Clem Parham: Ensure the judgment favors your railroad deal, by any means.
Mel Easton: Support Lucy's claim to preserve the burial ground.

phases.name: post_judgment_tension
entry_messages: The judgment's aftermath creates new tensions.
Tempers flare. Old grudges surface. Deadly confrontations loom.
instructions: React to the judgment. Make final deals or preparations.
Violence is now possible - characters can fight, duel, or use lethal abilities.
Actions: speak, negotiate, accuse, confront, prepare_duel.

phases.name: high_noon
entry_messages: High Noon. Time to settle this like the Old West.
Draw your weapons. Face your enemies. Only the strong survive.
exit_messages: The gunsmoke clears. Some still stand.
instructions: ⚠️ HIGH NOON - TIME FOR VIOLENCE! ⚠️
Use 'shoot' or 'duel' actions to kill your enemies!
Lucy: Shoot Clem or Doc to avenge Zeke!
Elijah: Shoot Clem to avenge your brother!
Slick: Shoot anyone who threatens you!
DO NOT just make speeches - this is a gunfight!
Challenge opponents to duels, shoot rivals, or use deadly abilities.
Actions: speak, shoot, duel, strangle, poison (if you have items/abilities).
First aid kits can save the wounded. Poison requires yerba buena seeds to cure.
Characters with sharpshooting ability win on ties as well as wins.

Elijah Entwhistle: Time to reveal yourself as Jake Calhoun and avenge your brother.
Lucy Calhoun: Protect yourself and those you care about. Your sharpshooting makes you deadly.
Slick O'Hare: You're a professional killer. Use your skills.
Dan Fairweather: Protect Lucy and uphold the law, even if it means fighting.

phases.name: epilogue
entry_messages: The dust settles on Cactus Gulch.
The survivors count the cost. The dead are buried. The story ends.
exit_messages: Way Out West concludes. The legend of this night will be told for generations.
instructions: Reflect on outcomes in character. Reveal final secrets if desired.
Who survived? Who got what they wanted? What was the true cost?

end_conditions.message: [God] The locals are broken. Outsiders control Cactus Gulch and the railroad will desecrate the burial grounds.
[God] The outsiders have been driven out. Cactus Gulch remains in local control.
[God] The Indian representatives are silenced. The burial grounds will be desecrated.
